NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses saying,
NASB.2: 'Send out for yourself men so that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I am going to give to the sons of Israel; you shall send a man from each of their fathers' tribes, every one a leader among them.'
NASB.3: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran at the command of the LORD, all of them men who were heads of the sons of Israel.
NASB.4: These then [were] their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
NASB.5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
NASB.6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
NASB.7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
NASB.8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
NASB.9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
NASB.10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
NASB.11: from the tribe of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
NASB.12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
NASB.13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
NASB.14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
NASB.15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
NASB.16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land; but Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
NASB.17: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he said to them, 'Go up there into the Negev; then go up into the hill country.
NASB.18: 'See what the land is like, and whether the people who live in it are strong [or] weak, whether they are few or many.
NASB.19: 'How is the land in which they live, is it good or bad? And how are the cities in which they live, are [they] like [open] camps or with fortifications?
NASB.20: 'How is the land, is it fat or lean? Are there trees in it or not? Make an effort then to get some of the fruit of the land.' Now the time was the time of the first ripe grapes.
NASB.21: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, at Lebo-hamath.
NASB.22: When they had gone up into the Negev, they came to Hebron where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
NASB.23: Then they came to the valley of Eshcol and from there cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes; and they carried it on a pole between two [men], with some of the pomegranates and the figs.
NASB.24: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the sons of Israel cut down from there.
NASB.25: When they returned from spying out the land, at the end of forty days,
NASB.26: they proceeded to come to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; and they brought back word to them and to all the congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.
NASB.27: Thus they told him, and said, 'We went in to the land where you sent us; and it certainly does flow with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
NASB.28: 'Nevertheless, the people who live in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified [and] very large; and moreover, we saw the descendants of Anak there.
NASB.29: 'Amalek is living in the land of the Negev and the Hittites and the Jebusites and the Amorites are living in the hill country, and the Canaanites are living by the sea and by the side of the Jordan.'
NASB.30: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, 'We should by all means go up and take possession of it, for we will surely overcome it.'
NASB.31: But the men who had gone up with him said, 'We are not able to go up against the people, for they are too strong for us.'
NASB.32: So they gave out to the sons of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, 'The land through which we have gone, in spying it out, is a land that devours its inhabitants; and all the people whom we saw in it are men of [great] size.
NASB.33: 'There also we saw the Nephilim (the sons of Anak are part of the Nephilim); and we became like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight.'

NKJV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.2: “Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a leader among them.”
NKJV.3: So Moses sent them from the Wilderness of Paran according to the command of the LORD, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
NKJV.4: Now these were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
NKJV.5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
NKJV.6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
NKJV.7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
NKJV.8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
NKJV.9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
NKJV.10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
NKJV.11: from the tribe of Joseph, that is, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
NKJV.12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
NKJV.13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
NKJV.14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
NKJV.15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
NKJV.16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
NKJV.17: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way into the South, and go up to the mountains,
NKJV.18: and see what the land is like: whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, few or many;
NKJV.19: whether the land they dwell in is good or bad; whether the cities they inhabit are like camps or strongholds;
NKJV.20: whether the land is rich or poor; and whether there are forests there or not. Be of good courage. And bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
NKJV.21: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near the entrance of Hamath.
NKJV.22: And they went up through the South and came to Hebron; Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
NKJV.23: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and there cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes; they carried it between two of them on a pole. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
NKJV.24: The place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the men of Israel cut down there.
NKJV.25: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.
NKJV.26: Now they departed and came back to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
NKJV.27: Then they told him, and said: “We went to the land where you sent us. It truly flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
NKJV.28: Nevertheless the people who dwell in the land are strong; the cities are fortified and very large; moreover we saw the descendants of Anak there.
NKJV.29: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the South; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Jordan.”
NKJV.30: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it.”
NKJV.31: But the men who had gone up with him said, “We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.”
NKJV.32: And they gave the children of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, “The land through which we have gone as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it are men of great stature.
NKJV.33: There we saw the giants ( the descendants of Anak came from the giants); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight.”

ESV.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel. From each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a chief among them.”
ESV.3: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran, according to the command of the LORD, all of them men who were heads of the people of Israel.
ESV.4: And these were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
ESV.5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
ESV.6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
ESV.7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
ESV.8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
ESV.9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
ESV.10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
ESV.11: from the tribe of Joseph (that is, from the tribe of Manasseh), Gaddi the son of Susi;
ESV.12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
ESV.13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
ESV.14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
ESV.15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
ESV.16: These were the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
ESV.17: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan and said to them, “Go up into the Negeb and go up into the hill country,
ESV.18: and see what the land is, and whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many,
ESV.19: and whether the land that they dwell in is good or bad, and whether the cities that they dwell in are camps or strongholds,
ESV.20: and whether the land is rich or poor, and whether there are trees in it or not. Be of good courage and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
ESV.21: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
ESV.22: They went up into the Negeb and came to Hebron. Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. (Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
ESV.23: And they came to the Valley of Eshcol and cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes, and they carried it on a pole between two of them; they also brought some pomegranates and figs.
ESV.24: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol,  because of the cluster that the people of Israel cut down from there.
ESV.25: At the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land.
ESV.26: And they came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the people of Israel in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh. They brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
ESV.27: And they told him, “We came to the land to which you sent us. It flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
ESV.28: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. And besides, we saw the descendants of Anak there.
ESV.29: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the Negeb. The Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill country. And the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and along the Jordan.”
ESV.30: But Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “Let us go up at once and occupy it, for we are well able to overcome it.”
ESV.31: Then the men who had gone up with him said, “We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are.”
ESV.32: So they brought to the people of Israel a bad report of the land that they had spied out, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people that we saw in it are of great height.
ESV.33: And there we saw the Nephilim (the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim), and we seemed to ourselves like grasshoppers, and so we seemed to them.”

NLT.1: The LORD now said to Moses,
NLT.2: “Send out men to explore the land of Canaan, the land I am giving to the Israelites. Send one leader from each of the twelve ancestral tribes.”
NLT.3: So Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He sent out twelve men, all tribal leaders of Israel, from their camp in the wilderness of Paran.
NLT.4:
These were the tribes and the names of their leaders: Tribe — Leader
Reuben — Shammua son of Zaccur
NLT.11: Manasseh son of Joseph — Gaddi son of Susi
NLT.16: These are the names of the men Moses sent out to explore the land. (Moses called Hoshea son of Nun by the name Joshua.)
NLT.17: Moses gave the men these instructions as he sent them out to explore the land: “Go north through the Negev into the hill country.
NLT.18: See what the land is like, and find out whether the people living there are strong or weak, few or many.
NLT.19: See what kind of land they live in. Is it good or bad? Do their towns have walls, or are they unprotected like open camps?
NLT.20: Is the soil fertile or poor? Are there many trees? Do your best to bring back samples of the crops you see.” (It happened to be the season for harvesting the first ripe grapes.)
NLT.21: So they went up and explored the land from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
NLT.22: Going north, they passed through the Negev and arrived at Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai — all descendants of Anak — lived. (The ancient town of Hebron was founded seven years before the Egyptian city of Zoan.)
NLT.23: When they came to the valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes so large that it took two of them to carry it on a pole between them! They also brought back samples of the pomegranates and figs.
NLT.24: That place was called the valley of Eshcol (which means “cluster”), because of the cluster of grapes the Israelite men cut there.
NLT.25: After exploring the land for forty days, the men returned
NLT.26: to Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel at Kadesh in the wilderness of Paran. They reported to the whole community what they had seen and showed them the fruit they had taken from the land.
NLT.27: This was their report to Moses: “We entered the land you sent us to explore, and it is indeed a bountiful country — a land flowing with milk and honey. Here is the kind of fruit it produces.
NLT.28: But the people living there are powerful, and their towns are large and fortified. We even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak!
NLT.29: The Amalekites live in the Negev, and the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country. The Canaanites live along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea and along the Jordan Valley.”
NLT.30: But Caleb tried to quiet the people as they stood before Moses. “Let’s go at once to take the land,” he said. “We can certainly conquer it!”
NLT.31: But the other men who had explored the land with him disagreed. “We can’t go up against them! They are stronger than we are!”
NLT.32: So they spread this bad report about the land among the Israelites: “The land we traveled through and explored will devour anyone who goes to live there. All the people we saw were huge.
NLT.33: We even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak. Next to them we felt like grasshoppers, and that’s what they thought, too!”

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am going to give to the sons of Israel. From each of their fathers' tribes you shall send a man, every one a leader among them."
AMP.3: So Moses sent spies from the Wilderness of Paran at the command of the LORD, all of them men who were heads of the Israelites.
AMP.4: These were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
AMP.5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
AMP.6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
AMP.7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
AMP.8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea [that is, Joshua] the son of Nun;
AMP.9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
AMP.10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
AMP.11: from the tribe of Joseph, that is, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
AMP.12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
AMP.13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
AMP.14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
AMP.15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
AMP.16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land; but Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua (the LORD is salvation).
AMP.17: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up this way into the Negev (the South country); then go up into the hill country.
AMP.18: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many,
AMP.19: and whether the land in which they live is good or bad, and whether the cities in which they live are [open] camps or fortifications,
AMP.20: and what the land is, whether it is fat (productive) or lean, whether there is timber on it or not. Make an effort to get some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the time of the first ripe grapes.
AMP.21: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin to Rehob [a town in Lebanon], at Lebo-hamath [in the far north].
AMP.22: When they had gone up into the Negev (the South country), they came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai the descendants of Anak were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
AMP.23: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol (cluster of grapes), and from there cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes; and they carried it on a pole between two of them, with some of pomegranates and the figs.
AMP.24: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol (cluster of grapes) because of the cluster of grapes which the sons of Israel cut down there.
AMP.25: When they returned from spying out the land, at the end of forty days,
AMP.26: they came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh, and brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the land's fruit.
AMP.27: They reported to Moses and said, "We went in to the land where you sent us; and it certainly does flow with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
AMP.28: But the people who live in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified (walled) and very large; moreover, we saw there the descendants of Anak [people of great stature and courage].
AMP.29: [The people descended from] Amalek live in the land of the Negev (South country); the Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the [Dead] Sea and along the side of the Jordan."
AMP.30: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, "Let us go up at once and take possession of it; for we will certainly conquer it."
AMP.31: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people [of Canaan], for they are too strong for us."
AMP.32: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land which they had spied out, saying, "The land through which we went, in spying it out, is a land that devours its inhabitants. And all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.
AMP.33: There we saw the Nephilim (the sons of Anak are part of the Nephilim); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."

MSG.2: "Send men to scout out the country of Canaan that I am giving to the People of Israel. Send one man from each ancestral tribe, each one a tried-and-true leader in the tribe."

These were their names:
from Reuben: Shammua son of Zaccur

MSG.10: from Zebulun: Gaddiel son of Sodi
MSG.11: from Manasseh (a Joseph tribe): Gaddi son of Susi
MSG.12: from Dan: Ammiel son of Gemalli
MSG.13: from Asher: Sethur son of Michael

NIV.1:
Exploring Canaan
The Lord said to Moses,
NIV.2: “Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders.”
NIV.3: So at the Lord’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.
NIV.4:
These are their names:
from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
NIV.5: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
NIV.6: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
NIV.7: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
NIV.8: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
NIV.9: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
NIV.10: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
NIV.11: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
NIV.12: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
NIV.13: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
NIV.14: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
NIV.15: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.
NIV.16: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)
NIV.17: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, “Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.
NIV.18: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.
NIV.19: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?
NIV.20: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees on it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
NIV.21: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.
NIV.22: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
NIV.23: When they reached the Valley of Eshcol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.
NIV.24: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.
NIV.25: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.
NIV.26:
Report on the Exploration
They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.
NIV.27: They gave Moses this account: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.
NIV.28: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.
NIV.29: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan.”
NIV.30: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, “We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it.”
NIV.31: But the men who had gone up with him said, “We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are.”
NIV.32: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, “The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.
NIV.33: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them.”
